items.label: Luxurious Materials
items.value: The Artisan couch from Valencia is fully upholstered in Italian Nappa Leather that is Italian tanned leather, offering unparalleled luxury and a premium feel that only top-quality materials can provide.

items.label: Elegant Design
items.value: This living room couch features a classic cognac tan shade, achieved only from the best grade of Italian Nappa leather that accentuates the natural beauty of the hide. Crafted from Italian genuine Nappa leather, it is extremely durable and resistant to scratching.

items.label: Distinctive Model
items.value: Each of our mid-century modern sofas stands out due to the unique depth of color in the genuine leather covers, making every piece one-of-a-kind. The design includes extremely plush leather cushions on both sides of the sofa giving you the optimal coziness and comfort.

items.label: Meticulous Details
items.value: Valencia goes above and beyond to exceed your expectations with Mahogany solid wood base with fine wood grain. The cushions are loose and non-reversible, ensuring both comfort and support. The couch's solid wood legs are finished in a rich mahogany tone that perfectly complements the cognac leather.

items.label: Effortless Assembly
items.value: The Italian leather sofa is designed for quick and easy setup, allowing you to assemble it within minutes and avoid any wasted time. Delivered right to your curb, this couch combines convenience with style.

items.value: The sofa requires assembly. Instructions are provided for quick and easy setup.
